Uses Diethyltoluamide is an insect repellent that is effective against mosquitoes as well as blackflies, harvest-bugs or chiggers, midg- es, ticks, and fleas. It is considered to be of value for personal protection against malaria (p.594). It has also been used as a re- pellent against leeches. It may be applied to skin and clothing. Preparations USP 31: Diethyltoluamide Topical Solution.
